items.source: Any number of TargetSourceCreator implementations can be used to create a custom target source: for example, to pool prototype objects. Auto-proxying will occur even if there is no advice, as long as a TargetSourceCreator specifies a custom TargetSource. If there are no TargetSourceCreators set, or if none matches, a SingletonTargetSource will be used by default to wrap the target bean instance.
items.translation: 可以使用任意数量的TargetSourceCreator实现来创建自定义目标源：例如，用于原型对象的池化。即使没有 Advice，只要 TargetSourceCreator 指定了自定义的TargetSource，也会发生自动代理。如果没有设置 TargetSourceCreator，或者没有一个匹配，默认将使用SingletonTargetSource来包装目标 Bean 实例。

items.source: TargetSourceCreators can only be invoked if this post processor is used in a BeanFactory and its BeanFactoryAware callback is triggered.
items.translation: TargetSourceCreators 仅可在该后置处理器在BeanFactory中使用且其BeanFactoryAware回调被触发时调用。

items.source: This class distinguishes between "common" interceptors: shared for all proxies it creates, and "specific" interceptors: unique per bean instance. There need not be any common interceptors. If there are, they are set using the interceptorNames property. As with ProxyFactoryBean, interceptors names in the current factory are used rather than bean references to allow correct handling of prototype advisors and interceptors: for example, to support stateful mixins. Any advice type is supported for "interceptorNames" entries.
items.translation: 该类区分“通用”拦截器：为所有其创建的代理共享，以及“特定”拦截器：每个 Bean 实例唯一。不一定需要任何通用拦截器；如果有，则使用 `interceptorNames` 属性设置。与 ProxyFactoryBean 一样，当前工厂中的拦截器名称（而非 Bean 引用）被使用，以便正确处理原型 Advisor 和拦截器：例如，支持有状态混入。任何 Advice 类型都支持用于 "interceptorNames" 条目。

items.source: This callback gives post-processors a chance to expose a wrapper early - that is, before the target bean instance is fully initialized. The exposed object should be equivalent to what BeanPostProcessor.postProcessBeforeInitialization(Object, String) / BeanPostProcessor.postProcessAfterInitialization(Object, String) would expose otherwise. Note that the object returned by this method will be used as the bean reference unless the post-processor returns a different wrapper from said post-process callbacks. In other words, those post-process callbacks may either eventually expose the same reference or alternatively return the raw bean instance from those subsequent callbacks (if the wrapper for the affected bean has been built for a call to this method already, it will be exposed as the final bean reference by default).
items.translation: 此回调允许后置处理器尽早暴露包装器——即在目标 Bean 实例完全初始化之前。所暴露的对象应与BeanPostProcessor.postProcessBeforeInitialization(Object, String) / BeanPostProcessor.postProcessAfterInitialization(Object, String) 原本会暴露的对象等效。请注意，此方法返回的对象将用作 Bean 引用，除非后置处理器从所述后置处理回调中返回了不同的包装器。换句话说，这些后置处理回调最终可能会暴露相同的引用，或者替代地返回来自后续回调的原始 Bean 实例（如果针对此方法的调用已经为受影响的 Bean 构建了包装器，则默认情况下它将作为最终的 Bean 引用被暴露）。

items.source: If a non-null object is returned by this method, the bean creation process will be short-circuited. The only further processing applied is the BeanPostProcessor.postProcessAfterInitialization(Object, String) callback from the configured BeanPostProcessors.
items.translation: 如果此方法返回一个非空对象，则 Bean 创建过程将被短路。唯一应用的进一步处理是配置的BeanPostProcessors中的BeanPostProcessor.postProcessAfterInitialization(Object, String)回调。

items.source: Note: As of 4.2.3, this implementation does not return a concatenated class/name String anymore but rather the most efficient cache key possible: a plain bean name, prepended with BeanFactory.FACTORY_BEAN_PREFIX in case of a FactoryBean; or if no bean name specified, then the given bean Class as-is.
items.translation: 注意：自 4.2.3 版本起，此实现不再返回拼接的类/名称 String，而是返回最有效的缓存键：对于 `FactoryBean`，以BeanFactory.FACTORY_BEAN_PREFIX前缀加上普通的 bean 名称；或者如果未指定 bean 名称，则直接返回给定的 bean Class。

items.source: Note that TargetSourceCreators will kick in even for target beans where no advices or advisors have been found. If a TargetSourceCreator returns a TargetSource for a specific bean, that bean will be proxied in any case.
items.translation: 请注意，即使未找到任何通知（advices）或顾问（advisors），`TargetSourceCreators` 也会针对目标 Bean 生效。如果某个特定的 Bean 的 `TargetSourceCreator` 返回了一个 `TargetSource`，则该 Bean 无论如何都会被代理。

items.source: Subclasses can apply any strategy to decide if a bean is to be proxied, for example, by type, by name, by definition details, etc. They can also return additional interceptors that should just be applied to the specific bean instance. A simple concrete implementation is BeanNameAutoProxyCreator, identifying the beans to be proxied via given names.
items.translation: 子类可以应用任何策略来决定是否对 Bean 进行代理，例如按类型、名称或定义细节等。它们还可以返回应仅应用于特定 Bean 实例的额外拦截器。一个简单的具体实现是BeanNameAutoProxyCreator，它通过给定的名称来识别需要代理的 Bean。

items.source:
Such auto-proxying is particularly useful if there's a large number of beans that
need to be wrapped with similar proxies, i.e. delegating to the same interceptors.
Instead of x repetitive proxy definitions for x target beans, you can register
one single such post processor with the bean factory to achieve the same effect.
items.translation: 这种自动代理功能在需要为大量 Bean 应用相似代理（即委托给相同的拦截器）时特别有用。您无需为 x 个目标 Bean 定义 x 次重复的代理配置，只需向 Bean 工厂注册一个此类后置处理器即可实现相同的效果。
